verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a financial-data aggregation platform like MX, but the evidence pack has no documentation of retention settings, purge policies, or end-user data deletion. Deleting webhooks in Client Dashboard and API key expiry after rotation are adjacent controls, not data retention or deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
